title: Finite etale schemes with descent data
statement: Let $g:Y'\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The category of finite etale descent data $\mathsf{DD}_{\mathrm{FEt}}(Y'/Y)$ has objects $(P',\varphi)$ in which $P'\to Y'$ is finite and etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] and $\varphi$ is a descent datum over $Y'/Y$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. Its morphisms are exactly the morphisms $P'\to Q'$ over $Y'$ compatible with the descent data.
